events.title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
events.description: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

events.title: Spain's King Felipe and Queen Letizia visit Ceuta
events.description: The royal couple have arrived for their first-ever visit to the exclave to show solidarity with residents.

events.title: Germany's China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
events.description: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

events.title: 125 years of Thomas Mann's 'Buddenbrooks'
events.description: This over 1,000-page masterpiece offers a panoramic view of society in the 19th century and exposes the collapse of a merchant family: unrecognized sons, disillusioned daughters and the loss of middle-class ideals.

events.title: In Kenya, recycled plastic gets a second life as chess pieces
events.description: In Nairobi, a project is helping children develop focus, patience and critical thinking through chess, using pieces made from recycled plastic waste.

events.title: Spanish royals visit Ceuta amid tensions with Morocco over migrant influx
events.description: Spain’s King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia visited Ceuta for the first time in 14 years on Tuesday, as the North African enclave grapples with the aftermath of a mass migrant influx. Authorities have cleared makeshift camps from the beaches ahead of the visit, amid strained relations with neighbouring Morocco.

events.title: Novelist Thélyson Orélien rejects AI claims after bestseller pulled from French prize list
events.description: Thélyson Orélien, the Haitian-Canadian writer whose best-selling debut novel was pulled from the prestigious Goncourt prize list amid an AI uproar, said Tuesday "not a single sentence" had been written by a machine. He did, however, admit to "unacceptable mistakes" regarding accusations of plagiarism involving earlier works.

events.title: Pope's lung surgery was successful and went as planned, Vatican says
events.description: The Pope's surgery to remove a small growth on one ‌of his lungs went "successfully and according to plan", the Vatican says.

events.title: Formula One to return to Africa for first time in 30 years
events.description: Formula One is set to return to Africa for the first time in more than three decades after Rwanda signed a 10-year deal to host the race.

events.title: Pope Leo cancels all public events ahead of lung surgery
events.description: Pope Leo has cancelled all planned public events until Tuesday 20 October, ahead of surgery to remove a small growth on one of his lungs.

events.title: Alleged Irish crime boss will 'vehemently defend' himself in court and apply for bail
events.description: Alleged Irish crime boss Daniel Kinahan will "vehemently defend" the case against him and plans to seek bail, his solicitor says.

events.title: Prosecutors drop 3 impeachment charges against Philippine VP to speed up trial
events.description: Philippine prosecutors have dropped three of four impeachment charges against Vice President Sara Duterte to speed up her ongoing trial

events.title: 20 green sea turtles returned to the ocean after Bali smuggling raid
events.description: Indonesian authorities on the tourist island of Bali have released 20 protected green sea turtles back into the ocean Tuesday

events.title: Passenger train derails in central Pakistan, killing at least 5 and injuring 35
events.description: Officials in Pakistan say a passenger train has derailed, killing five people and injuring 35 others

events.title: Congo's ex-President Kabila launches an anti-government front including M23 rebels
events.description: Former Congolese President Joseph Kabila has launched a new political and military coalition against the current government

events.title: Rebels set off a car bomb outside toll booth as fighting intensifies in Colombia's Cauca region
events.description: A car bomb exploded at a toll booth in southwestern Colombia injuring at least three civilians
events.ticker_label: 💥 Rebels set off a car bomb outside toll booth as fighting intensifies in Colombia's Cauca region

events.title: Burnham says Russian meddling in Europe shows need for closer UK-EU ties as he seeks a Brexit reset
events.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says Russia's attempts to meddle in European politics highlight why Britain must strengthen ties with the European Union

events.title: Mom accused of driving car off cliff with young kids inside, faces DUI, child neglect charges
events.description: Chase Ryan Klinedinst allegedly drove off a Chattanooga cliff with two children inside, landing upside down near railroad tracks, police say.

events.title: 911 operators questioned whether Christa Pike failed execution call was prank, audio reveals
events.description: 911 audio reveals dispatchers initially dismissed Christa Pike's failed execution as a prank call, delaying the ambulance response to Riverbend Prison.

events.title: FBI operation targets scam compounds in Africa with arrests, account takedowns
events.description: Operation Blackout's latest raids across Ghana and Nigeria netted 28 arrests, freed trafficked workers and saw Meta remove 3.7 million accounts.

events.title: Trump's new press secretary takes the podium after weeks-long White House shake-up and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Feds arrest man on Nantucket in early morning operation involving multiple felony charges
events.description: Rigoberto Chavez-Regaldo faces child trafficking and aggravated rape charges after a multi-agency arrest operation on Nantucket, Massachusetts.

events.title: US military archbishop urges Catholic soldiers to refuse involvement in Army firing squad execution
events.description: Archbishop Timothy Broglio urged Catholic soldiers to refuse firing squad duty in the planned execution of Nidal Hasan, calling the livestream barbaric.

events.title: Man admits to dismembering ex-girlfriend, keeping severed head in suitcase after she played him 'like a fool'
events.description: A New York man pleaded guilty to second-degree murder after he admitted that he murdered and dismembered his ex-girlfriend and kept her severed head in a suitcase.

events.title: Woman poisoned by coworker at Berkeley lab releases hidden-camera video as he seeks felony dismissal
events.description: Rong Yuan released hidden camera video appearing to show David Xu pouring a substance into her water bottle as he seeks to dismiss his felony conviction.

events.title: Coworker accused of slashing woman’s throat during ride home, victim escaped moving car: police
events.description: A New York man allegedly slashed a coworker's throat during a ride home in Saratoga Springs before she escaped the moving car.

events.title: Retired police sergeant shoots deputy chief wife and their daughter in wealthy, coastal enclave home
events.description: Ann Mannix, San Francisco's first female SWAT commander, and her daughter Katie were found dead in their Mill Valley home in a suspected murder-suicide.

events.title: Idaho professor falsely accused of student murders by TikTok psychic reveals fear for children's safety
events.description: Rebecca Scofield describes sleepless nights guarding her children after TikTok psychic Ashley Guillard accused her in the University of Idaho murders.

events.title: Pope Leo surgery to remove lung nodule was successful, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage."
events.ticker_label: 💥 Pope Leo surgery to remove lung nodule was successful, Vatican says

events.title: Abbas delays Palestinian elections again, making more than two decades without vote
events.description: Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas delayed elections to 2027, extending a nearly 20-year wait as Israel and Hamas clash over the blame.

events.title: Pope Leo announces tumor on lung, surgery planned in 'next few days'
events.description: Pope Leo XIV announced doctors found a lung nodule at a "very early stage," with surgery scheduled in coming days.

events.title: Who is Navi Pillay? Nobel Peace Prize winner's UN record renews fierce antisemitism accusations
events.description: Navi Pillay's 2026 Nobel Peace Prize sparked backlash from Jewish advocacy groups and UN Watch over allegations of anti-Israel bias and antisemitism.
